static_traits.name: Han Na
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends, but has not yet talked to them about Fear; avoiding water-related social activities affects interaction with family and friends
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; without psychotherapy or counseling history; without similar prior swimming/water-related problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, can concretely describe event details; emotions mainly fear, accompanied by doubt but willing to try change; thinking fairly logical, cooperativeness fairly high

basic_info.main_problem: After being swept by the tide at the beach weeks ago and nearly drowning, feeling 'I am a terrible swimmer', triggering persistent Fear and a sense of inadequacy, and avoiding any water-related activities.
basic_info.core_demands: The beach incident and fear of swimming have significantly affected my daily life and activities, so I came to seek counseling.

special_situations.event: A few weeks ago while swimming at the beach, was caught in a strong tide and briefly worried about drowning
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I mishandle once or struggle to get free, it means I generally cannot swim and my ability is poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Completely avoiding water-related environments (beaches, swimming pools), in order to lower the possibility of failing again or of danger occurring
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows I swim poorly; I might drown

special_situations.event: Environments near the beach or pool (seeing large bodies of water)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go near water, I will definitely lose control and misfortune will happen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately moves away from water, refuses to approach or be exposed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As soon as I enter the water something will happen; I will definitely be pulled away

special_situations.event: Invitations from friends or family to organize beach or water activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I join, I will drag everyone down and make them worry, showing I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Declining invitations, reducing social contact to avoid being judged or troubling others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will disappoint everyone; I will become a burden

core_conflict.wish: Longing to stay safe and in control in the water, able to enjoy swimming and outdoor activities with peace of mind
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being swallowed by uncontrollable forces (such as tides), losing control and drowning
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of security and lowering Anxiety by avoiding waters and related situations

object_relations.self_representation: A helpless trapped person in water situations, easily swallowed
object_relations.object_representation: Powerful and uncontrollable external forces/environment (ocean, tides)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling discussion approaches water areas or gradually challenges the belief 'I am bad at this'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe changing thoughts may not be safe enough or may be ineffective, worrying about falling into danger again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing safety concerns in a cautious, tactful tone, emphasizing 'no rush, take it slow', remaining reserved about directly facing Fear.

manifestations: After a near-drowning experience at the beach, intense worry and fear about drowning
Approaching waters immediately produces intense Anxiety and avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Skeptical of cognitive change but cautiously tries
Tends to limit participation in water-related activities on grounds of 'safer'
Overly restrains oneself when facing water-related situations

positive_force: Once enjoyed swimming, showing a certain foundation of positive experiences
In a dangerous situation, ultimately succeeded in returning to shore, showing a certain perseverance and coping ability
Has a supportive network of friends
Work functioning not affected, daily structure stable
negative_force: Catastrophic and future-predicting thoughts intensify Fear
Overgeneralization and personalization lead to self-labeling ('I am a terrible swimmer')
Broadly avoiding water-related environments, reinforcing the Fear cycle
Not yet actively seeking Social support or trying strategies

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Fear of water environments and broad avoidance (thinking of swimming or approaching water triggers Anxiety)
antecedent: Seeing or approaching beaches / pools and other water
Receiving an invitation to a water-related social event
Recalling the experience of being swept by the tide at the beach
target_behavior.core_reason: The harrowing experience of being swept by the tide at the beach triggers catastrophic cognitions about drowning, and overgeneralizes one event as overall insufficient ability, accompanied by personalized self-blame
target_behavior.function: Escaping situations seen as dangerous to quickly lower Anxiety, gaining short-term security
target_behavior.consequence: Restricted social and leisure activities, unable to join water-related activities with family and friends, Decreased enjoyment of life, maintaining and reinforcing Fear
